name: Bald cypress
desc: Bald cypress (Taxodium distichum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Taxodium distichum, the bald cypress, bald-cypress, baldcypress, or swamp cypress; French: cyprès chauve; cipre in Louisiana) is a deciduous conifer in the cypress family, Cupressaceae.
